INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Independent Contractor Services Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of March 3, 2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Halverson Brands LLC, a Delaware limited liability company with offices at 4400 Winton Avenue, Suite 210, Chicago, Illinois ("Client"), and the individual or entity identified on the signature page ("Contractor"). Client and Contractor are each a "party" and together the "parties."

1. ENGAGEMENT

Client engages Contractor on a non-exclusive basis to perform the brand identity and design services described in Exhibit A (the "Services"), and Contractor accepts that engagement on the terms set out below. Contractor performs the Services as an independent contractor and not as an employee, partner, joint venturer, or agent of Client. Contractor is responsible for the manner and means by which the Services are performed, subject to the requirements of this Agreement, and will supply Contractor's own equipment, software, and workspace.

2. SCOPE OF SERVICES

Exhibit A describes the deliverables, the delivery schedule, and the review process for the Services. Client may modify, add to, or otherwise revise the Services and the deliverables described in Exhibit A at any time upon written notice to Contractor, and the Fee shall remain unchanged. Contractor shall perform the Services in accordance with Client's written brand guidelines and industry standards that Client may update from time to time. Contractor will attend one status call each week at a time the parties agree in advance, and will respond to Client's routine questions within two business days.

3. FEE AND INVOICING

As full consideration for the Services and for the rights assigned under Section 6, Client will pay Contractor a fixed fee of $14,000 (the "Fee"), invoiced in three installments as set out in Exhibit A. Contractor shall submit each invoice through Client's vendor portal together with the supporting documentation Client reasonably requests. Payment becomes due only after Client, in its sole discretion, accepts the deliverables as satisfactory, and no time limit applies to Client's review. Contractor is responsible for all taxes on amounts paid under this Agreement, and Client will report payments on IRS Form 1099 where required by law.

4. EXPENSES

Client will reimburse Contractor for pre-approved out-of-pocket expenses that Contractor documents with receipts within thirty days of the date the expense was incurred. Any single expense over $250 requires Client's written approval before it is incurred. No markup may be applied to a reimbursed expense.

5. TERM AND TERMINATION

This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues until the Services are completed and accepted, unless terminated earlier under this Section. Client may terminate this Agreement at any time and for any reason upon written notice, and Client shall have no obligation to pay for Services performed but not yet accepted as of the date of termination. Contractor may terminate this Agreement only if Client commits a material breach that remains uncured sixty days after Contractor gives written notice describing the breach. Sections 6 through 13 survive termination or expiration of this Agreement.

6. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

Contractor assigns to Client all right, title, and interest in every work of authorship, invention, and improvement conceived by Contractor during the term of this Agreement, whether or not related to the Services and whether or not created using Client's materials or time. Contractor waives any moral rights in the assigned work to the extent the law permits and will sign any further documents Client reasonably requests in order to record the assignment. Contractor retains no license to use the assigned work except as Section 9 expressly permits.

7. CONFIDENTIALITY

Each party will hold the other party's confidential information in confidence and use it only as needed to perform this Agreement. Confidential information does not include information that becomes public through no fault of the receiving party, that the receiving party already held free of any obligation of confidence, or that the receiving party develops independently without reference to the disclosing party's information. These obligations continue for three years after this Agreement ends.

8. INDEMNITY

Contractor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Client and its officers, employees, and affiliates against any and all claims, damages, losses, and expenses of any kind arising out of or related to the Services, without limitation as to amount. Contractor will not settle any claim covered by this Section without Client's written consent. Client will notify Contractor of any claim for which Client seeks indemnity within a reasonable time after Client learns of it.

9. PUBLICITY

Neither party shall issue any public statement, portfolio entry, or case study describing the Services without the other party's prior written consent. Each party may include the other party's name in an internal client or vendor list and may disclose this engagement where a regulator, auditor, or court requires it.

10. NON-COMPETITION AND NON-SOLICITATION

For a period of three years after this Agreement ends, Contractor shall not provide services of any kind to any person or entity that competes with Client in any market in which Client operates or plans to operate. For one year after this Agreement ends, Contractor shall not solicit for employment any person then employed or engaged by Client whom Contractor met through the Services.

11. REPRESENTATIONS AND COMPLIANCE

Contractor represents that Contractor has the right to enter into this Agreement and that the Services will not knowingly infringe the intellectual property rights of a third party. Contractor will comply with the laws that apply to Contractor's performance of the Services and with Client's written site and security policies while on Client premises or on Client systems. Contractor will keep records of hours and materials relating to the Services for two years and will make them available to Client on reasonable request.

12. GOVERNING LAW, JURISDICTION, AND NOTICES

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of North Dakota, and each party consents to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state courts sitting in Cass County, North Dakota. Notices under this Agreement must be in writing and delivered by hand, by overnight courier, or by certified mail to the addresses set out on the signature page. A notice is effective when it is received or, in the case of certified mail, three business days after it is posted.

13. GENERAL

Contractor may not assign this Agreement or subcontract any part of the Services without Client's prior written consent, and Client may assign this Agreement to an affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger or a sale of substantially all of its assets. This Agreement, together with Exhibit A, is the entire agreement between the parties about its subject matter and replaces any prior proposal, estimate, or conversation. This Agreement may be amended only by a writing signed by both parties. A party's failure to enforce a provision is not a waiver of that provision. If a provision is held unenforceable, the rest of this Agreement remains in effect and the unenforceable provision is limited to the minimum extent necessary. This Agreement may be signed in counterparts, including by electronic signature, each of which is an original.
